overlapGuard: React Query's own behaviour, no extra guard: an interval tick calls Query.fetch with no cancelRefetch, and a fetch that is not idle returns the running read (@tanstack/query-core 5.104.0 src/query.ts:594-608; the interval in src/queryObserver.ts:529-534). apps/studio/src/api/queries.test.ts holds a read open across three intervals and sees one request, then the next one five seconds later.
workBoardRequestsHow: useWorkBoard and queryKeys.workBoard deleted; rg finds no '/api/v1/work-board' request in apps/studio/src outside the local data layer (local/routes.ts, local/handlers.ts), which is read-only for this task. BatchesPage.test.tsx renders the page and finds only the work-queue query in the cache.
batchColumnsWhy: The work-queue item (GetResponse<'/api/v1/work-queue'>['items'][number]) carries no stage and no readiness, so the page takes its no-board branch: no stage filter, no Stage or Readiness column, no count cards.
